thread:
ryan: Heads-up: Canary rollout surfaced weird provisional charges when stream reconnects + toolcall truncation. Observed double provisional entries for same user session. Anyone seen this?

nidhi: Yep — saw this in staging on Dedicated. Reconnect within ~3s kept creating new provisional ledger rows instead of attaching to the original session_id.

sam: Is this just retry dedupe again or something different? How are we generating session ids today?

ryan: We generate session_id at stream-open server-side and return it, but LB rewrites or clients drop headers during reconnect so the server ends up creating a new session_id -> new provisional entry.

jess: Proposed quick fix: require clients to send an `x-rw-session` header and treat reconnects with same id as the same session. But that will break older SDKs that don't set it.

nidhi: Alternative (server-side): do stitching by detecting prefix overlap. Keep a small KV of recent prefixes keyed by `<client_ip|api_key, prefix_hash>` with a grace window (10s). If reconnect shows overlap > N tokens, attach to original session. Less breaking for SDKs.

ryan: Example sketch of server-side stitcher heuristic:
```
on_stream_open: create provisional ledger entry with session_id
on_chunk_emit: increment provisional tokens (session_id)
on_reconnect: if incoming.session_id == missing && prefix_overlap(tokens) > 20 -> attach to existing session_id else create new provisional
on_stream_close: finalize provisional -> commit tokens
```

ellen: Telemetry ask: we need explicit events for `stream.open`, `chunk.emit(length)`, `toolcall.open`, `toolcall.close`, `stream.close` with `session_id`, `request_id`, `prefix_hash`, and `provisional_token_delta`. Console needs to show provisional vs final breakdown per request id + trace link.

billing-bot: FYI provisional entries already exist in the billing ledger as `provisional` rows but are not surfaced in the usage UI. :eyes: We can add a flag to expose them.

sam: UX idea: show "estimated tokens (finalizing...)" in Console with a link to the trace/stream. For canary, add a red flag on requests that were stitched/merged so billing folks can filter.

ryan: Open question: if a toolcall truncates mid-toolcall and client retries, how do we avoid charging the first half-tool and the retry? One thought: only finalize charges on `toolcall.close` or on explicit stream-close ack. But that could delay finalization and affect real-time billing.

nidhi: I lean to commit only on `toolcall.close`. For partial runs where client retries, use prefix-suffix overlap dedupe: if retry's first N tokens overlap with previous provisional suffix, don't double-charge. N could be 30 tokens.

jess: For backward compat and rollout safety: implement server-side stitching first, expose console toggle to turn it on per-org (canary) and make `x-rw-session` header opt-in in SDKs. That gives us a migration path.

sam: I'll draft the SDK PR to start setting `x-rw-session` and update examples/docs. Also will add UX copy for "estimated tokens (finalizing...)".

ryan: Action items: sam -> SDK PR and docs, nidhi -> prototype stitcher + tests + metrics, jess -> console toggle + rollout plan, ellen -> telemetry events spec + dashboard mocks. Sync tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:

jess: Adding note — rollouts: keep the canary toggle on orgs with heavy streaming so we can verify no regression in latency before global flip.

ellen: I'll add the telemetry event schema to the ticket and wire a sample dashboard panel showing provisional vs committed tokens by request_id.

billing-bot: Ticket created: BILL-4523 "stitching: provisional charge dedupe for stream reconnects" — assigned to nidhi.

ryan: Thanks all — will follow up in PR threads.
